## Episode Thesis

In this segment the host interviews Nina Jönsson, CEO of the delisted grocery group ICA Gruppen, about its strong four-month report. Sales rose 5% to SEK 51bn and the operating margin went from 4.3% to 5.4%. She credits the cut in VAT on food, efficiency gains and market-share wins in every unit (ICA stores, Apotek Hjärtat, the bank and insurance), while noting that part of the gain comes from comparing against last year's one-off double loyalty bonus. The tone is positive about Swedish grocery demand and shoppers who stay price-conscious, but nothing tradable comes out of it: ICA is unlisted and gives no date for returning to the stock exchange.
